import cyclopts

        default="pyproject.toml",
        search_dirs=["."],
        hint_var="tool.mycli",
    )
)

@app.default
def main(
    name: str = "",
    verbose: bool = False,
    output: str = "output.txt",
):
    """Process data with options from [tool.mycli] in pyproject.toml.
    
    Config file values serve as defaults.
    Explicit CLI arguments override config file values.
    """
    print(f"Name: {name}")
    print(f"Verbose: {verbose}")
    print(f"Output: {output}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app()
